findings.evidence: The declarations at lines 164–166 and 332–335 conclude only `IsSelfAdjoint (convolutionOperator k)` and `convolutionOperator k ... ≠ 0`; `rg` finds no convolution-operator compactness theorem in the imported compact-group modules.
findings.fix: State that these results provide the self-adjointness/nonvanishing inputs and that the spectral theorem applies only after compactness is established separately.
findings.issue: The docstrings for `isSelfAdjoint_convolutionOperator` and `exists_isMollifier_convolutionOperator_toLp_ne_zero` (lines 162–163 and 326–331) overclaim that they yield an operator to which the compact self-adjoint spectral theorem applies; their statements prove self-adjointness and nonvanishing, but not compactness.

summary: Two docstrings incorrectly claim that the spectral theorem already applies, although this module establishes no compactness result for convolution operators.
